# API reference

All SDK methods use lowerCamelCase. Native Roblox APIs keep engine casing.

Types are available from the named source/Roblox module; `Types/*` is the public wire-contract namespace.
Underscore members and module constructors other than `BloxSDK.new` are private implementation details.

## BloxSDK

Source: [src/BloxSDK.luau](../../src/BloxSDK.luau)

### Root values and utility functions

```luau
SDK.version = "1.1.0"
SDK.serviceAccount = ServiceAccount.new
SDK.userSession = UserSession.new
SDK.memoryTokenStore = UserSession.memoryStore
SDK.null = Json.null
```

No internal module tables are exported. Utility signatures below are resolved from their source definitions.

### `SDK.serviceAccount`

Capture the credential privately; provider tables and errors never contain it.

```luau
SDK.serviceAccount(
	key: string | Types.Secret,
	universeId: string | number,
	levels: Types.ServiceLevels?
): Types.AuthProvider
```

Definition: [src/Auth/ServiceAccount.luau](../../src/Auth/ServiceAccount.luau).

### `SDK.userSession`

Build a versioned, single-flight session. One refresh/replay per original authorization epoch.

```luau
SDK.userSession(runtime: Types.Runtime, store: TokenStore?, role: Auth.AccountType?): Session
```

Definition: [src/Auth/UserSession.luau](../../src/Auth/UserSession.luau).

### `SDK.memoryTokenStore`

Make a private in-memory store; persistence is a caller-supplied security decision.

```luau
SDK.memoryTokenStore(): TokenStore
```

Definition: [src/Auth/UserSession.luau](../../src/Auth/UserSession.luau).

### `SDK.array`

Mark an otherwise ambiguous empty array; nonempty dense arrays need no marker.

```luau
SDK.array<T>(value: { T }): { T }
```

Definition: [src/Core/Json.luau](../../src/Core/Json.luau).

### `SDK.object`

Mark an explicitly object-shaped JSON value, distinguishing {} from [] at decode boundaries.

```luau
SDK.object<T>(value: T): T
```

Definition: [src/Core/Json.luau](../../src/Core/Json.luau).

### `SDK.pages`

Build a bounded lazy page iterator; preserve failures instead of silently truncating lists.

```luau
SDK.pages<T>(
	fetch: (number) -> Types.Result<T>,
	isLast: (T) -> boolean,
	maximum: number?
): () -> Types.Result<T>?
```

Definition: [src/Core/Pagination.luau](../../src/Core/Pagination.luau).

### `SDK.cursorPages`

Iterate opaque cursor pages with a finite bound and cycle detection, yielding errors once.

```luau
SDK.cursorPages<T>(
	fetch: (string?) -> Types.Result<T>,
	nextCursor: (T) -> (string | Types.Null)?,
	maximum: number?,
	initial: string?
): () -> Types.Result<T>?
```

Definition: [src/Core/Pagination.luau](../../src/Core/Pagination.luau).

### `SDK.new`

Create one server-side SDK client; invalid configuration fails before any network activity.

```luau
SDK.new(config: Config): Client
```

### `Client.withUniverse`

Return another scoped facade over the same physical resource and credential lifetime.

```luau
Client.withUniverse(self: Client, id: string | number): Client
```

### `Client.scoped`

Bind downstream calls to a cached scoped JWT; retain the root client for identity management.

```luau
Client.scoped(self: Client, id: string | number): Client
```

### `Client.health`

Check every service health route, returning individual status and monotonic latency.

```luau
Client.health(self: Client): HealthReport
```

### `Client.logout`

Log out with the latest rotated refresh token; clear local credentials even on server failure.

```luau
Client.logout(self: Client): Types.Result<AuthTypes.LogoutResultValue>
```

### `Client.metrics`

Snapshot counters and non-cumulative latency buckets without exposing mutable internal state.

```luau
Client.metrics(self: Client): Metrics
```

### `Client.flush`

Stop admission and drain; returns false when the finite shutdown budget expires.

```luau
Client.flush(self: Client, timeout: number?): boolean
```

### `Client.destroy`

Idempotently terminate the client and all universe facades.

```luau
Client.destroy(self: Client)
```

### `Client.auditWriter`

Create a nonblocking audit queue owned by this client; native Roblox clients bind shutdown once.

```luau
Client.auditWriter(self: Client, options: AuditWriter.Options?): AuditWriter.Writer
```

### `Client.runtimeSnapshot`

Start a fault-tolerant snapshot poller, scoped to this facade and owned by the shared lifetime.

```luau
Client.runtimeSnapshot(self: Client, interval: number?): SnapshotCache.Snapshot
```

## Config

Source: [src/Core/Config.luau](../../src/Core/Config.luau)

### `Config.validate`

Validate structural configuration without rendering values or credentials in messages.

```luau
Config.validate(config: Config)
```

### `Config.number`

Validate numeric policy before allocating state; errors include field names, never values.

```luau
Config.number(
	value: number?,
	default: number,
	minimum: number,
	maximum: number,
	name: string,
	integer: boolean?
): number
```

### `Config.resolve`

Resolve immutable wire bases separately from origins so gateway services share admission state.

```luau
Config.resolve(config: Config): ({ [string]: string }, { [string]: string })
```

```luau
export type Null = { __bloxNull: true }
```
